_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: Add checks for completing every 10 levels in an item world.  You will still be required to go to Item World to unlock chapter 3 even if this is disabled.
Adds checks for learning all weapon ablilities and spells.  Also adds items to the manual to enable use of these abilities.

Adds checks for every generic character class unlock and each rank of those characters, aside from the initial 8 base generics.  Also adds items to the manual that allow you to create those characters.
Note that some classes require high levels to unlock their final form.
Adds checks for collecting every item in the game.  While there is no limiter to have them in your inventory, turning this on will also add items to the manual in order to use/equip each item.
Note that turning this on will NOT enable checks for hard to get items, such as all the rank 39 and 40 weapons.

Adds checks for killing every type of monster, including every sub type in every species.  This option adds a lot of tedious checks as about 1/3 of the monsters in game can only be found at the Dark Assembly or in the Item World.
You can check your progress on the create character screen as you only can create monsters you have killed at least one of.
